phases.objective: Run the existing CI and branch diagnostic workflows for pull requests targeting either governed protected branch without changing their test commands.

e2e_journeys.actor: pull request author promoting reviewed code to a protected branch
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A pull request targeting a branch listed in repository-maintenance-tool-governance protected_branches
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The unchanged CI job set and full branch diagnostic suite execute on the exact GitHub pull-request candidate for both governed protected branches.
steps: Read the protected branch policy containing main and Production.
Match the pull-request target against the CI trigger.
Match the pull-request target against the branch diagnostic trigger.
Execute syntax, unit and integration, runtime startup, architecture, and execution resolver gates.
Execute the ordered full test suite and family diagnostic shards.
assertions: CI lists both governed protected branches in its pull-request trigger.
Branch Test Diagnostic lists both governed protected branches in its pull-request trigger.
Existing CI job names and npm test execution remain present.
Existing sequential and family diagnostic execution remain present.
No migration, deployment, provider call, or repository mutation is introduced.

phases.objective: Preserve exact-candidate and durable test evidence for protected-branch release review using the existing workflow contracts and artifacts.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: CI and Branch Test Diagnostic workflow results for a protected-target pull request
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The reviewer receives full CI results plus diagnostic artifacts and an ordered-suite result tied to the exact pull-request candidate SHA.
steps: Run CI on the pull-request merge ref.
Run family diagnostics and the ordered manifest suite on the same pull-request merge ref.
Upload per-family reports and the bounded diagnostic summary.
Record the tested ref, exact SHA, family count, selected count, failures, and sequential result.
assertions: The diagnostic artifact path uses matrix expressions and cannot resolve to a literal shell-variable filename.
The diagnostic summary contract remains mad4b.test-diagnostic-summary.v2.
Job logs remain diagnostic-only and are not substituted for structured results.

phases.objective: Fail closed if protected-branch validation loses a governed target, write authority is introduced, or diagnostic artifacts regress to unresolved shell-variable paths.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A change to CI or Branch Test Diagnostic workflow definitions
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The contract test rejects missing protected targets, missing full-suite markers, write permissions, work-branch literals, or broken diagnostic artifact paths before merge.
steps: Load both workflow definitions and the protected branch policy.
Assert both governed targets remain configured.
Assert required CI and diagnostic execution markers remain present.
Reject diagnostic upload paths that do not use matrix expressions.
assertions: No work-branch name is embedded in either permanent workflow.
Both main and Production remain covered.
Broken report upload paths fail the contract test.
Secrets are not added to the workflow or reports.

phases.objective: Observe the first reviewed main-to-Production promotion and confirm both full validation workflows publish exact-candidate results without duplicate or stale authority.
Require successful exact-candidate CI and diagnostic evidence before every future protected-branch promotion.
